comparison.objective: Candidate fractures insert tangs; record plastically bends a straight steel bar into a rectangular stirrup.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate delivers localized impact through a coaxial mandrel and recovers fragments; record indexes a bar between chalk marks and swings a bending lever for three same-direction right-angle bends.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four notch fractures without insert/shell damage and containment of all fragments; record requires an 80 × 50 mm rectangular stirrup with meeting ends, while reverse bending is scrap. No specs are provided.
comparison.reason: Both involve irreversible material change, but controlled tang separation and recovery test a different mechanism and end state from sequential bulk plastic bending.
